column20:
SELECT cp.ID, cp.COMPANY_NAME_VN , cp.EQUITY_TICKER , cp.bond_ticker, aa.*
FROM GMS_IDS_UAT.company_profiles cp JOIN 
(        SELECT * 
        FROM (--điểm cấp 2
                SELECT ev.evaluation_date,
                company_id, ep.YEAR||lpad(ep.MONTH,2,0) AS per
                , eg.group_cd, sum(ed.score) AS diem
                FROM GMS_IDS_UAT.evaluations ev
                JOIN GMS_IDS_UAT.evaluation_periods ep ON ep.id = ev.period_id AND upper(ep.STATUS) ='APPROVED'
                JOIN GMS_IDS_UAT.evaluation_details ed ON ed.evaluation_id = ev.id
                JOIN GMS_IDS_UAT.evaluation_criteria ec ON ec.id = ed.criterion_id
                JOIN GMS_IDS_UAT.evaluation_groups eg ON eg.id = ec.group_id
                WHERE 1=1
                AND eg.group_cd IN ('TUAN_THU', 'PHAT_HANH', 'TAI_CHINH', 'PHI_TAI_CHINH')
                Group by company_id, eg.group_cd, ep.YEAR||lpad(ep.MONTH,2,0), ev.evaluation_date
                --        điểm tổng (cấp 1)
                UNION ALL
                SELECT ev.evaluation_date        ,
                company_id, ep.YEAR||lpad(ep.MONTH,2,0) AS per
                , 'TONG' group_cd, ev.total_score AS diem
                FROM GMS_IDS_UAT.evaluations ev
                JOIN GMS_IDS_UAT.evaluation_periods ep ON ep.id = ev.period_id AND upper(ep.STATUS) ='APPROVED'
                WHERE 1=1
                --điểm cấp 3
                UNION ALL
                SELECT ev.evaluation_date,
                company_id, ep.YEAR||lpad(ep.MONTH,2,0) AS per
                , criterion_cd, ed.score AS diem_phat_hanh_nhanh
                FROM GMS_IDS_UAT.evaluation_details ed
                JOIN GMS_IDS_UAT.evaluation_criteria ec ON ec.id = ed.criterion_id
                JOIN GMS_IDS_UAT.evaluation_groups eg ON eg.id = ec.group_id
                JOIN GMS_IDS_UAT.evaluations ev ON ev.id = ed.evaluation_id
                JOIN GMS_IDS_UAT.evaluation_periods ep ON ep.id = ev.period_id AND upper(ep.STATUS) ='APPROVED'
                WHERE ec.criterion_cd = 'PHAT_HANH_TIN_NHIEM'
                AND eg.group_cd = 'PHAT_HANH'
                )
        pivot  (sum(diem)
                FOR group_cd IN ('TONG' AS TONG, 'TUAN_THU' AS TUAN_THU, 'PHAT_HANH' AS PHAT_HANH, 'TAI_CHINH' AS TAI_CHINH, 'PHI_TAI_CHINH' AS PHI_TAI_CHINH
                                                ,'PHAT_HANH_TIN_NHIEM' AS PHAT_HANH_TIN_NHIEM
                                                )
                        ) 
) aa ON cp.id = aa.COMPANY_ID 
--AND cp.EQUITY_TICKER = 'DNL'
AND per = '202607'
;

(	SELECT * 
	FROM (--điểm cấp 3
		SELECT ev.evaluation_date,
		company_id, ep.YEAR||lpad(ep.MONTH,2,0) AS per
		, criterion_cd, ed.score AS diem
		FROM GMS_IDS_UAT.evaluation_details ed

		AND eg.group_cd = 'TUAN_THU'
		AND ec.criterion_cd in ('TUAN_THU_BCTC', 'TUAN_THU_BCTN', 'TUAN_THU_BCTHQT', 'TUAN_THU_CBTTBT_TDTGD', 'TUAN_THU_VP_UBCK',

		--điểm cấp 2

column9: CTDC, ngày
column20:
SELECT cp.ID, cp.COMPANY_NAME_VN , cp.EQUITY_TICKER , cp.bond_ticker, aa.*
FROM GMS_IDS_UAT.company_profiles cp JOIN 
(	SELECT * 
	FROM (--điểm cấp 3
		SELECT ev.evaluation_date,
		company_id, ep.YEAR||lpad(ep.MONTH,2,0) AS per
		, criterion_cd, ed.score AS diem
		FROM GMS_IDS_UAT.evaluation_details ed
		JOIN GMS_IDS_UAT.evaluation_criteria ec ON ec.id = ed.criterion_id
		JOIN GMS_IDS_UAT.evaluation_groups eg ON eg.id = ec.group_id
		JOIN GMS_IDS_UAT.evaluations ev ON ev.id = ed.evaluation_id
		JOIN GMS_IDS_UAT.evaluation_periods ep ON ep.id = ev.period_id AND upper(ep.STATUS) ='APPROVED'
		WHERE 1=1
		AND eg.group_cd = 'PHAT_HANH'
		AND ec.criterion_cd in ('PHAT_HANH_TANG_VON_NHANH', 'PHAT_HANH_SLCBCPRL', 'PHAT_HANH_SLCBRCC', 'PHAT_HANH_SLPHES',
              					'PHAT_HANH_TLGTTP', 'PHAT_HANH_TIN_NHIEM', 'PHAT_HANH_DNTPTVCSH')
		--điểm cấp 2
		UNION ALL
		SELECT ev.evaluation_date,
		company_id, ep.YEAR||lpad(ep.MONTH,2,0) AS per
		, eg.group_cd, sum(ed.score) AS diem
		FROM GMS_IDS_UAT.evaluations ev
		JOIN GMS_IDS_UAT.evaluation_periods ep ON ep.id = ev.period_id AND upper(ep.STATUS) ='APPROVED'
		JOIN GMS_IDS_UAT.evaluation_details ed ON ed.evaluation_id = ev.id
		JOIN GMS_IDS_UAT.evaluation_criteria ec ON ec.id = ed.criterion_id
		JOIN GMS_IDS_UAT.evaluation_groups eg ON eg.id = ec.group_id

SELECT cp.ID, cp.COMPANY_NAME_VN , cp.EQUITY_TICKER , cp.bond_ticker, aa.*
FROM GMS_IDS_UAT.company_profiles cp JOIN 
(        SELECT * 
        FROM (--điểm cấp 3
                SELECT ev.evaluation_date,
                company_id, ep.YEAR||lpad(ep.MONTH,2,0) AS per
                , criterion_cd, ed.score AS diem
                FROM GMS_IDS_UAT.evaluation_details ed
                JOIN GMS_IDS_UAT.evaluation_criteria ec ON ec.id = ed.criterion_id
                JOIN GMS_IDS_UAT.evaluation_groups eg ON eg.id = ec.group_id
                JOIN GMS_IDS_UAT.evaluations ev ON ev.id = ed.evaluation_id
                JOIN GMS_IDS_UAT.evaluation_periods ep ON ep.id = ev.period_id AND upper(ep.STATUS) ='APPROVED'
                WHERE 1=1
                AND eg.group_cd = 'TAI_CHINH'
                AND ec.criterion_cd in ('TAI_CHINH_YKKT', 'TAI_CHINH_DTTHDKD', 'TAI_CHINH_KNTTHT', 'TAI_CHINH_EBIT', 'TAI_CHINH_NO_VON_CSH',
              'TAI_CHINH_VON_CSH', 'TAI_CHINH_ROA', 'TAI_CHINH_ROE', 'TAI_CHINH_DTHDTC_LNST', 'TAI_CHINH_DTHD_KHAC_LNST')
                --điểm cấp 2
                UNION ALL
                SELECT ev.evaluation_date,
                company_id, ep.YEAR||lpad(ep.MONTH,2,0) AS per
                , eg.group_cd, sum(ed.score) AS diem
                FROM GMS_IDS_UAT.evaluations ev
                JOIN GMS_IDS_UAT.evaluation_periods ep ON ep.id = ev.period_id AND upper(ep.STATUS) ='APPROVED'
                JOIN GMS_IDS_UAT.evaluation_details ed ON ed.evaluation_id = ev.id
                JOIN GMS_IDS_UAT.evaluation_criteria ec ON ec.id = ed.criterion_id
                JOIN GMS_IDS_UAT.evaluation_groups eg ON eg.id = ec.group_id
                WHERE 1=1
                AND eg.group_cd = 'TAI_CHINH'
                Group by company_id, eg.group_cd, ep.YEAR||lpad(ep.MONTH,2,0), ev.evaluation_date
                )
        pivot  (sum(diem)
                FOR criterion_cd IN ('TAI_CHINH' AS TONG, 'TAI_CHINH_YKKT' AS YKKT, 'TAI_CHINH_DTTHDKD' AS DTTHDKD, 'TAI_CHINH_KNTTHT' AS KNTTHT, 'TAI_CHINH_EBIT' AS EBIT, 'TAI_CHINH_NO_VON_CSH' AS NO_VON_CSH,

                        ) 
) aa ON cp.id = aa.COMPANY_ID

SELECT cp.ID, cp.COMPANY_NAME_VN , cp.EQUITY_TICKER , cp.bond_ticker, aa.*
FROM GMS_IDS_UAT.company_profiles cp JOIN 
(        SELECT * 
        FROM (--điểm cấp 3
                SELECT ev.evaluation_date,
                company_id, ep.YEAR||lpad(ep.MONTH,2,0) AS per
                , criterion_cd, ed.score AS diem
                FROM GMS_IDS_UAT.evaluation_details ed
                JOIN GMS_IDS_UAT.evaluation_criteria ec ON ec.id = ed.criterion_id
                JOIN GMS_IDS_UAT.evaluation_groups eg ON eg.id = ec.group_id
                JOIN GMS_IDS_UAT.evaluations ev ON ev.id = ed.evaluation_id
                JOIN GMS_IDS_UAT.evaluation_periods ep ON ep.id = ev.period_id AND upper(ep.STATUS) ='APPROVED'
                WHERE 1=1
                AND eg.group_cd = 'PHI_TAI_CHINH'
                AND ec.criterion_cd in ('PHI_TAI_CHINH_TTHD', 'PHI_TAI_CHINH_M_SCORE')
                --điểm cấp 2
                UNION ALL
                SELECT ev.evaluation_date,
                company_id, ep.YEAR||lpad(ep.MONTH,2,0) AS per
                , eg.group_cd, sum(ed.score) AS diem
                FROM GMS_IDS_UAT.evaluations ev
                JOIN GMS_IDS_UAT.evaluation_periods ep ON ep.id = ev.period_id AND upper(ep.STATUS) ='APPROVED'
                JOIN GMS_IDS_UAT.evaluation_details ed ON ed.evaluation_id = ev.id
                JOIN GMS_IDS_UAT.evaluation_criteria ec ON ec.id = ed.criterion_id
                JOIN GMS_IDS_UAT.evaluation_groups eg ON eg.id = ec.group_id
                WHERE 1=1
                AND eg.group_cd = 'PHI_TAI_CHINH'
                Group by company_id, eg.group_cd, ep.YEAR||lpad(ep.MONTH,2,0), ev.evaluation_date
                )
        pivot  (sum(diem)
                FOR criterion_cd IN ('PHI_TAI_CHINH' AS TONG, 'PHI_TAI_CHINH_TTHD' AS TTHD, 'PHI_TAI_CHINH_M_SCORE' AS M_SCORE
                                                )
                        ) 
) aa ON cp.id = aa.COMPANY_ID 
--AND cp.EQUITY_TICKER = 'DNL'
AND per = '202607'

WITH
/* BƯỚC 1:

   - Ưu tiên loại báo cáo: HN -> TH -> ME -> RI

*/
Company_data_chuan AS (
    SELECT
        company_profile_id,
        report_year,
        report_quarter,
        company_data_id,
        form_cd, form_tp,
        submission_date
    FROM (
        SELECT
            cd.company_profile_id,
            cd.report_year,
            cd.report_quarter,
            cd.id AS company_data_id,
            f.form_cd,
                        substr(f.form_cd,1,2) as form_tp,
            cd.submission_date,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY cd.company_profile_id, cd.report_year, cd.report_quarter
                ORDER BY CASE         WHEN f.form_cd LIKE 'HN%' THEN 1
                                                                WHEN f.form_cd LIKE 'TH%' THEN 2
                                                                WHEN f.form_cd LIKE 'ME%' THEN 3
                                                                WHEN f.form_cd LIKE 'RI%' THEN 4
                                                        END, cd.submission_date DESC) AS rn
        FROM GMS_IDS_UAT.company_data cd
        JOIN GMS_IDS_UAT.forms f ON f.id = cd.form_id AND f.news_type_cd = 'DINH_KY'
        WHERE cd.news_status_cd = 'APPROVED'
    )
    WHERE rn = 1
),
/* =========================================================
   BƯỚC 2: tính các chỉ tiêu theo từng DN, từng kỳ
   - Từ các kỳ hợp lệ ở trên, lấy chỉ tiêu trong DATA
   - DATA join bằng: company_profile_id + report_year + report_quarter
   - Điều kiện FINANCIAL_STATEMENT_CD = form_tp
   - Cùng chỉ tiêu: lấy create_date mới nhất
   ========================================================= */
Chitiet_DN as
(        SELECT
                company_profile_id, equity_ticker, equity_listing_exch, category_l1_id,
                report_year, report_quarter, data_value
        FROM (
                Select x.*,
                ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY x.company_profile_id, x.report_year, x.report_quarter ORDER BY x.created_date DESC ) AS rn
                FROM (
                        SELECT cdc.company_profile_id, cp.equity_ticker, cp.equity_listing_exch, cp.category_l1_id ,
                        cdc.report_year, cdc.report_quarter,
                        d.data_value,
                        d.created_date
                        FROM Company_data_chuan cdc
                        JOIN GMS_IDS_UAT.company_profiles cp ON cp.id = cdc.company_profile_id
                        JOIN GMS_IDS_UAT.data d ON d.company_profile_id = cdc.company_profile_id
                                AND d.report_year = cdc.report_year
                                AND d.report_quarter = cdc.report_quarter
                        JOIN GMS_IDS_UAT.report_catalog rc ON rc.id = d.report_catalog_id and cdc.form_tp = rc.FINANCIAL_STATEMENT_CD
                        JOIN GMS_IDS_UAT.rrow rr ON rr.row_cd = d.row_cd AND rr.report_catalog_id = d.report_catalog_id
                        JOIN GMS_IDS_UAT.rcol rc2 ON rc2.col_cd = d.col_cd AND rc2.report_catalog_id = d.report_catalog_id
                        WHERE rc2.col_desc = '1' AND rc.report_cd LIKE 'BCKQKD%'
                                        AND cp.status_ids_cd  = 'APPROVED_PUBLIC'
                                        AND ((upper(rc.enterprise_type_cd)='DN' AND rr.row_desc='60')
                                        OR (upper(rc.enterprise_type_cd)='BH' AND rr.row_desc='60')
                                        OR (upper(rc.enterprise_type_cd)='TD' AND rr.row_desc='21'))
                        ) x
                )
        WHERE rn = 1
)

Chitiet_DN as
(        SELECT
                company_profile_id, equity_ticker, equity_listing_exch, category_l1_id, --enterprise_type_cd, 
                report_year, report_quarter,
                CASE WHEN col_desc = '1' AND report_cd LIKE 'BCDKT%'
                                AND ((upper(enterprise_type_cd)='DN' AND row_desc='270')
                                OR (upper(enterprise_type_cd)='BH' AND row_desc='270')
                                OR (upper(enterprise_type_cd)='TD' AND row_desc='300')) THEN 'TAI_SAN'
                        WHEN col_desc = '1' AND report_cd LIKE 'BCDKT%'
                                AND ((upper(enterprise_type_cd)='DN' AND row_desc='300')
                                OR (upper(enterprise_type_cd)='BH' AND row_desc='300')
                                OR (upper(enterprise_type_cd)='TD' AND row_desc='400'))         THEN 'NO_PT'
                        WHEN col_desc = '1' AND report_cd LIKE 'BCDKT%'
                                AND ((upper(enterprise_type_cd)='DN' AND row_desc='400')
                                OR (upper(enterprise_type_cd)='BH' AND row_desc='400')
                                OR (upper(enterprise_type_cd)='TD' AND row_desc='500'))        THEN 'VCSH'
                        WHEN col_desc = '1' AND report_cd LIKE 'BCDKT%'
                                AND ((upper(enterprise_type_cd)='DN' AND row_desc='411')
                                OR (upper(enterprise_type_cd)='BH' AND row_desc='411')
                                OR (upper(enterprise_type_cd)='TD' AND row_desc='411'))        THEN 'VDL'
                        WHEN col_desc = '1' AND report_cd LIKE 'BCKQKD%'
                                AND ((upper(enterprise_type_cd)='DN' AND row_desc='60')
                                OR (upper(enterprise_type_cd)='BH' AND row_desc='60')
                                OR (upper(enterprise_type_cd)='TD' AND row_desc='21'))        THEN 'LNST'
                        WHEN col_desc = '2' AND report_cd LIKE 'BCDKT%'
                                AND ((upper(enterprise_type_cd)='DN' AND row_desc='270')
                                OR (upper(enterprise_type_cd)='BH' AND row_desc='270')
                                OR (upper(enterprise_type_cd)='TD' AND row_desc='300')) THEN 'TAI_SAN_DK'
                        WHEN col_desc = '2' AND report_cd LIKE 'BCDKT%'
                                AND ((upper(enterprise_type_cd)='DN' AND row_desc='400')
                                OR (upper(enterprise_type_cd)='BH' AND row_desc='400')
                                OR (upper(enterprise_type_cd)='TD' AND row_desc='500'))        THEN 'VCSH_DK'
                        WHEN col_desc = '1' AND report_cd LIKE 'BCDKT%'
                                AND ((upper(enterprise_type_cd)='DN' AND row_desc='140')
                                OR (upper(enterprise_type_cd)='BH' AND row_desc='140')) THEN 'HTK'--TD không có HTK
                        WHEN col_desc = '1' AND report_cd LIKE 'BCKQKD%'
                                AND ((upper(enterprise_type_cd)='DN' AND row_desc='10')
                                OR (upper(enterprise_type_cd)='BH' AND row_desc='10')
                                OR (upper(enterprise_type_cd)='TD' AND row_desc='03'))        THEN 'DOANH_THU'
                        WHEN col_desc = '1' AND report_cd LIKE 'BCDKT%'
                                AND ((upper(enterprise_type_cd)='DN' AND row_desc='421')
                                OR (upper(enterprise_type_cd)='BH' AND row_desc='421'))        THEN 'LN_YTD'
                        WHEN col_desc = '1' AND report_cd LIKE 'BCDKT%'
                                AND ((upper(enterprise_type_cd)='DN' AND row_desc IN ('130', '210'))
                                OR (upper(enterprise_type_cd)='BH' AND row_desc IN ('130', '210'))
                                OR (upper(enterprise_type_cd)='TD' AND row_desc IN ('251'))) THEN 'PHAI_THU'
                        WHEN col_desc = '1' AND report_cd LIKE 'BCDKT%'
                                AND ((upper(enterprise_type_cd)='DN' AND row_desc='110')
                                OR (upper(enterprise_type_cd)='BH' AND row_desc='110')
                                OR (upper(enterprise_type_cd)='TD' AND row_desc IN ('110','120'))) THEN 'TIEN'
                        WHEN col_desc = '1' AND report_cd LIKE 'BCKQKD%'
                                AND ((upper(enterprise_type_cd)='DN' AND row_desc='50')
                                OR (upper(enterprise_type_cd)='BH' AND row_desc='50')
                                OR (upper(enterprise_type_cd)='TD' AND row_desc='17'))        THEN 'LNTT'
                                END AS chi_tieu,
                data_value
        FROM (
                Select x.*,
                ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY x.company_profile_id, x.report_year, x.report_quarter, x.row_id, x.col_id ORDER BY x.created_date DESC, x.updated_date DESC, x.data_id DESC) AS rn
                FROM (
                        SELECT 
                                cdc.company_profile_id, cp.equity_ticker, cp.equity_listing_exch, cp.category_l1_id , rc.enterprise_type_cd,
                                cdc.report_year, cdc.report_quarter,rc.report_cd, rc2.id as col_id, rc2.col_desc, rr.id as row_id, rr.row_desc,
                                d.data_value,

                        JOIN GMS_IDS_UAT.company_profiles cp ON cp.id = cdc.company_profile_id
                        JOIN GMS_IDS_UAT.data d ON d.company_profile_id = cdc.company_profile_id

                                AND d.report_quarter = cdc.report_quarter
                        JOIN GMS_IDS_UAT.report_catalog rc ON rc.id = d.report_catalog_id and cdc.form_tp = rc.FINANCIAL_STATEMENT_CD
                        JOIN GMS_IDS_UAT.rrow rr ON rr.row_cd = d.row_cd  AND rr.report_catalog_id = d.report_catalog_id
                        JOIN GMS_IDS_UAT.rcol rc2 ON rc2.col_cd = d.col_cd AND rc2.report_catalog_id = d.report_catalog_id
                        WHERE 1=1--
                                --and UPPER(rc.enterprise_type_cd) = 'DN'
                                --AND rc.report_cd LIKE 'BCDKT%'
                                AND rc2.col_desc IN ('1', '2')--chỉ tiêu cuối kỳ, thay bằng 2 để test chỉ tiêu cuối kỳ
                        ) x
                )
        WHERE rn = 1
)
/* ----------------------------------------
BƯỚC 3.1: Nếu tính các chỉ tiêu chi tiết DN
*/
Select         company_profile_id, equity_ticker, equity_listing_exch, category_l1_id,
        report_year, report_quarter,
        c.INDUSTRY_CD||'-'||c.INDUSTRY_NAME AS NNKD,
        TAI_SAN,TAI_SAN_DK,
        NO_PT,
        VCSH, VCSH_DK,
        VDL,
        LNST,
        --Nếu đầu kỳ null thì mẫu số =(cuối + cuối)/2 = cuối, tương tự nếu cuối kỳ null thì mẫu số = đầu, nếu cả 2 null thì ROA=null
        LNST/NULLIF((NVL(TAI_SAN_DK, TAI_SAN)+ NVL(TAI_SAN, TAI_SAN_DK))/2,0)*100 as ROA,        
        LNST/NULLIF((NVL(VCSH_DK, VCSH)+ NVL(VCSH, VCSH_DK))/2,0)*100 as ROE,
        HTK,
        DOANH_THU,
        LN_YTD,
        PHAI_THU,
        TIEN,
        NO_PT/NULLIF(VCSH,0) AS D_E,
        LNTT
FROM 
(        SELECT * 
        FROM Chitiet_DN
        pivot (sum(data_value)
                FOR chi_tieu IN (
                        'TAI_SAN'         AS TAI_SAN,
                        'NO_PT'          AS NO_PT,
                        'VCSH'                  AS VCSH,
                        'VDL'                  AS VDL,
                        'LNST'                  AS LNST,
                        'TAI_SAN_DK' AS TAI_SAN_DK,
                        'VCSH_DK'          AS VCSH_DK,
                        'HTK'                  AS HTK,
                        'DOANH_THU'  AS DOANH_THU,
                        'LN_YTD'          AS LN_YTD,
                        'PHAI_THU'          AS PHAI_THU,
                        'TIEN'                  AS TIEN,
                        'LNTT'                  AS LNTT
                        )
                )
        ) ct
LEFT JOIN GMS_IDS_UAT.CATEGORIES c ON c.ID = ct.category_l1_id
where 1=1 
        AND report_year in (:p_year)
        --AND report_quarter = (:p_quarter)
        --AND report_year = 2024 AND report_quarter = 3 AND company_profile_id = 1230
ORDER BY company_profile_id, equity_ticker, report_year, report_quarter

WITH Company_data_chuan AS (...),
Chitiet_DN as (...)
--Bước 1,2, giống mục 7
/* -------------------------------------------
BƯỚC 3.2: Nếu tính các chỉ tiêu theo sàn, ngành
*/
SELECT 
        category_l1_id,
        report_year, report_quarter,
        c.INDUSTRY_CD||'-'||c.INDUSTRY_NAME AS NNKD,
        count(1)         AS SL,
        SUM(TAI_SAN) AS TAI_SAN,
        SUM(NO_PT)         AS NO_PT,
        SUM(VCSH)        AS VCSH,
        SUM(VDL)        AS VDL,
        SUM(LNST)        AS LNST,
        --Nếu đầu kỳ null thì mẫu số =(cuối + cuối)/2 = cuối, tương tự nếu cuối kỳ null thì mẫu số = đầu, nếu cả 2 null thì ROA=null
        SUM(LNST)/NULLIF(SUM((NVL(TAI_SAN_DK, TAI_SAN)+ NVL(TAI_SAN, TAI_SAN_DK))/2),0)*100 as ROA,        
        SUM(LNST)/NULLIF(SUM((NVL(VCSH_DK, VCSH)+ NVL(VCSH, VCSH_DK))/2),0)*100 as ROE,
        SUM(TAI_SAN_DK)        AS TAI_SAN_DK,
        SUM(HTK)                AS HTK,
        SUM(DOANH_THU)        AS DOANH_THU,
        SUM(LN_YTD)         AS LN_YTD,
        SUM(PHAI_THU)        AS PHAI_THU,
        SUM(TIEN)                AS TIEN,
        SUM(NO_PT)/NULLIF(SUM(VCSH),0) AS D_E
FROM Chitiet_DN ct
LEFT JOIN GMS_IDS_UAT.CATEGORIES c ON c.ID = ct.category_l1_id
where 1=1 
        AND report_year = :p_year
        AND report_quarter = :p_quarter
GROUP BY category_l1_id, report_year, report_quarter, c.INDUSTRY_CD||'-'||c.INDUSTRY_NAME
ORDER BY category_l1_id, report_year, report_quarter

  SELECT cd.id, cd.company_profile_id,
  SUM(CASE WHEN rc2.col_desc = '2' THEN d.data_value ELSE 0 END) AS ts_dau,
  SUM(CASE WHEN rc2.col_desc = '1' THEN d.data_value ELSE 0 END) AS ts_cuoi
  FROM IDS.data d
  JOIN IDS.report_catalog rc ON d.report_catalog_id=rc.id
 JOIN IDS.rrow rr ON rr.row_cd = d.row_cd AND rr.report_catalog_id = d.report_catalog_id

  OR (upper(rc.enterprise_type_cd)='TD' AND rr.row_desc='300'))
  GROUP BY cd.id, cd.company_profile_id

  SELECT cd.id, cd.company_profile_id, SUM(d.data_value) AS lnst
  FROM IDS.data d
  JOIN IDS.report_catalog rc ON d.report_catalog_id=rc.id
 JOIN IDS.rrow rr ON rr.row_cd = d.row_cd AND rr.report_catalog_id = d.report_catalog_id

  JOIN ids.company_data cd ON d.COMPANY_PROFILE_ID  = cd.COMPANY_PROFILE_ID AND cd.report_year=d.report_year AND cd.report_quarter=d.report_quarter
  WHERE rc2.col_desc = '1'

SELECT 
        equity_listing_exch, category_l1_id,
        report_year, report_quarter,
        c.INDUSTRY_CD||'-'||c.INDUSTRY_NAME AS NNKD,
        count(1)         AS SL,
        SUM(TAI_SAN) AS TAI_SAN,
        SUM(NO_PT)         AS NO_PT,
        SUM(VCSH)        AS VCSH,
        SUM(VDL)        AS VDL,
        SUM(LNST)        AS LNST,
        --Nếu đầu kỳ null thì mẫu số =(cuối + cuối)/2 = cuối, tương tự nếu cuối kỳ null thì mẫu số = đầu, nếu cả 2 null thì ROA=null
        SUM(LNST)/NULLIF(SUM((NVL(TAI_SAN_DK, TAI_SAN)+ NVL(TAI_SAN, TAI_SAN_DK))/2),0)*100 as ROA,        
        SUM(LNST)/NULLIF(SUM((NVL(VCSH_DK, VCSH)+ NVL(VCSH, VCSH_DK))/2),0)*100 as ROE,
        SUM(TAI_SAN_DK)        AS TAI_SAN_DK,
        SUM(HTK)                AS HTK,
        SUM(DOANH_THU)        AS DOANH_THU,
        SUM(LN_YTD)         AS LN_YTD,
        SUM(PHAI_THU)        AS PHAI_THU,
        SUM(TIEN)                AS TIEN,
        SUM(NO_PT)/NULLIF(SUM(VCSH),0) AS D_E

LEFT JOIN GMS_IDS_UAT.CATEGORIES c ON c.ID = ct.category_l1_id

WITH Company_data_chuan AS (...),
Chitiet_DN as (...)
--Bước 1,2, giống mục 7
/* -------------------------------------------
BƯỚC 3.3: Nếu tính các chỉ tiêu theo sàn, ngành
*/
SELECT 
        equity_listing_exch,
        report_year, report_quarter,
        count(1)         AS SL,
        SUM(TAI_SAN) AS TAI_SAN,
        SUM(NO_PT)         AS NO_PT,
        SUM(VCSH)        AS VCSH,
        SUM(VDL)        AS VDL,
        SUM(LNST)        AS LNST,
        --Nếu đầu kỳ null thì mẫu số =(cuối + cuối)/2 = cuối, tương tự nếu cuối kỳ null thì mẫu số = đầu, nếu cả 2 null thì ROA=null
        SUM(LNST)/NULLIF(SUM((NVL(TAI_SAN_DK, TAI_SAN)+ NVL(TAI_SAN, TAI_SAN_DK))/2),0)*100 as ROA,        
        SUM(LNST)/NULLIF(SUM((NVL(VCSH_DK, VCSH)+ NVL(VCSH, VCSH_DK))/2),0)*100 as ROE,
        SUM(TAI_SAN_DK)        AS TAI_SAN_DK,
        SUM(HTK)                AS HTK,
        SUM(DOANH_THU)        AS DOANH_THU,
        SUM(LN_YTD)         AS LN_YTD,
        SUM(PHAI_THU)        AS PHAI_THU,
        SUM(TIEN)                AS TIEN,
        SUM(NO_PT)/NULLIF(SUM(VCSH),0) AS D_E
FROM Chitiet_DN 
where 1=1 
        AND report_year = :p_year
        AND report_quarter = :p_quarter
        AND equity_listing_exch= 'HOSE'
GROUP BY equity_listing_exch, report_year, report_quarter
ORDER BY equity_listing_exch, report_year, report_quarter

-- ROA = LNST / Tổng tài sản bình quân * 100%
 -- TSBQ = (TS đầu kỳ + TS cuối kỳ) / 2
 WITH ts_bq AS (
  SELECT cd.id,
  SUM(CASE WHEN rc2.col_desc = '2' THEN d.data_value ELSE 0 END) AS ts_dau,
  SUM(CASE WHEN rc2.col_desc = '1' THEN d.data_value ELSE 0 END) AS ts_cuoi
  FROM IDS.data d
  JOIN IDS.report_catalog rc ON d.report_catalog_id=rc.id
 JOIN IDS.rrow rr ON rr.row_cd = d.row_cd AND rr.report_catalog_id = d.report_catalog_id
 JOIN IDS.rcol rc2 ON rc2.col_cd = d.col_cd AND rc2.report_catalog_id = d.report_catalog_id
  JOIN ids.company_data cd ON d.COMPANY_PROFILE_ID  = cd.COMPANY_PROFILE_ID AND cd.report_year=d.report_year AND cd.report_quarter=d.report_quarter
  WHERE cd.report_year=:year AND cd.report_quarter=:quarter
  AND rc.report_cd LIKE 'BCDKT%'
  AND ((upper(rc.enterprise_type_cd)='DN' AND rr.row_desc='270')
  OR (upper(rc.enterprise_type_cd)='BH' AND rr.row_desc='270')
  OR (upper(rc.enterprise_type_cd)='TD' AND rr.row_desc='300'))
  GROUP BY cd.id
 ), lnst AS (
  SELECT cd.id, SUM(d.data_value) AS lnst
  FROM IDS.data d
  JOIN IDS.report_catalog rc ON d.report_catalog_id=rc.id
 JOIN IDS.rrow rr ON rr.row_cd = d.row_cd AND rr.report_catalog_id = d.report_catalog_id
 JOIN IDS.rcol rc2 ON rc2.col_cd = d.col_cd AND rc2.report_catalog_id = d.report_catalog_id
  JOIN ids.company_data cd ON d.COMPANY_PROFILE_ID  = cd.COMPANY_PROFILE_ID AND cd.report_year=d.report_year AND cd.report_quarter=d.report_quarter
  WHERE rc2.col_desc = '1'
  AND rc.report_cd LIKE 'BCKQKD%' AND d.report_year=:year AND d.report_quarter=:quarter
  AND ((upper(rc.enterprise_type_cd)='DN' AND rr.row_desc='60')
  OR (upper(rc.enterprise_type_cd)='BH' AND rr.row_desc='60')
  OR (upper(rc.enterprise_type_cd)='TD' AND rr.row_desc='21'))
  GROUP BY cd.id
 )
 SELECT cdet.equity_listing_exch, SUM(l.lnst) / NULLIF(SUM(
  CASE WHEN t.ts_dau IS NULL THEN t.ts_cuoi
  WHEN t.ts_cuoi IS NULL THEN t.ts_dau
  ELSE (t.ts_dau+t.ts_cuoi)/2 END),0)*100 AS roa_pct
 FROM ts_bq t JOIN lnst l ON l.id=t.id
JOIN IDS.company_profiles cdet ON cdet.id=t.company_profile_id
where cdet.equity_listing_exch = 'HOSE'
GROUP BY cdet.equity_listing_exch

  OR (upper(rc.enterprise_type_cd)='TD' AND rr.row_desc='300'))
  GROUP BY cd.id

 )

  SELECT cd.id,

  SUM(CASE WHEN rc2.col_desc = '1' THEN d.data_value ELSE 0 END) AS ts_cuoi
  FROM IDS.data d
  JOIN IDS.report_catalog rc ON d.report_catalog_id=rc.id

  WHERE cd.report_year=:year AND cd.report_quarter=:quarter

  OR (upper(rc.enterprise_type_cd)='TD' AND rr.row_desc='300'))
  GROUP BY cd.id

  JOIN ids.company_data cd ON d.COMPANY_PROFILE_ID  = cd.COMPANY_PROFILE_ID AND cd.report_year=d.report_year AND cd.report_quarter=d.report_quarter

  GROUP BY cd.id
 )

-- ROA = LNST / Tổng tài sản bình quân * 100%
 -- TSBQ = (TS đầu kỳ + TS cuối kỳ) / 2
 WITH ts_bq AS (
  SELECT cd.id,
  SUM(CASE WHEN rc2.col_desc = '2' THEN d.data_value ELSE 0 END) AS ts_dau,
  SUM(CASE WHEN rc2.col_desc = '1' THEN d.data_value ELSE 0 END) AS ts_cuoi
  FROM IDS.data d
  JOIN IDS.report_catalog rc ON d.report_catalog_id=rc.id
 JOIN IDS.rrow rr ON rr.row_cd = d.row_cd AND rr.report_catalog_id = d.report_catalog_id
 JOIN IDS.rcol rc2 ON rc2.col_cd = d.col_cd AND rc2.report_catalog_id = d.report_catalog_id
  JOIN ids.company_data cd ON d.COMPANY_PROFILE_ID  = cd.COMPANY_PROFILE_ID AND cd.report_year=d.report_year AND cd.report_quarter=d.report_quarter
  WHERE cd.report_year=:year AND cd.report_quarter=:quarter
  AND rc.report_cd LIKE 'BCDKT%'
  AND ((upper(rc.enterprise_type_cd)='DN' AND rr.row_desc='270')
  OR (upper(rc.enterprise_type_cd)='BH' AND rr.row_desc='270')
  OR (upper(rc.enterprise_type_cd)='TD' AND rr.row_desc='300'))
  GROUP BY cd.id
 ), lnst AS (
  SELECT cd.id, SUM(d.data_value) AS lnst
  FROM IDS.data d
  JOIN IDS.report_catalog rc ON d.report_catalog_id=rc.id
 JOIN IDS.rrow rr ON rr.row_cd = d.row_cd AND rr.report_catalog_id = d.report_catalog_id
 JOIN IDS.rcol rc2 ON rc2.col_cd = d.col_cd AND rc2.report_catalog_id = d.report_catalog_id
  JOIN ids.company_data cd ON d.COMPANY_PROFILE_ID  = cd.COMPANY_PROFILE_ID AND cd.report_year=d.report_year AND cd.report_quarter=d.report_quarter
  WHERE rc2.col_desc = '1'
  AND rc.report_cd LIKE 'BCKQKD%' AND d.report_year=:year AND d.report_quarter=:quarter
  AND ((upper(rc.enterprise_type_cd)='DN' AND rr.row_desc='60')
  OR (upper(rc.enterprise_type_cd)='BH' AND rr.row_desc='60')
  OR (upper(rc.enterprise_type_cd)='TD' AND rr.row_desc='21'))
  GROUP BY cd.id
 )
 SELECT cdet.category_l1_id, cdet.equity_listing_exch, SUM(l.lnst) / NULLIF(SUM(
  CASE WHEN t.ts_dau IS NULL THEN t.ts_cuoi
  WHEN t.ts_cuoi IS NULL THEN t.ts_dau
  ELSE (t.ts_dau+t.ts_cuoi)/2 END),0)*100 AS roa_pct
 FROM ts_bq t JOIN lnst l ON l.id=t.id
JOIN IDS.company_profiles cdet ON cdet.id=t.company_profile_id
AND cdet.equity_listing_exch = 'UPCOM'

        SUM(TAI_SAN) AS TAI_SAN,
        SUM(NO_PT)         AS NO_PT,

        SUM(VDL)        AS VDL,

        SUM(LNST)/NULLIF(SUM((NVL(TAI_SAN_DK, TAI_SAN)+ NVL(TAI_SAN, TAI_SAN_DK))/2),0)*100 as ROA,        
        SUM(LNST)/NULLIF(SUM((NVL(VCSH_DK, VCSH)+ NVL(VCSH, VCSH_DK))/2),0)*100 as ROE,
        SUM(TAI_SAN_DK)        AS TAI_SAN_DK,
        SUM(HTK)                AS HTK,
        SUM(DOANH_THU)        AS DOANH_THU,
        SUM(LN_YTD)         AS LN_YTD,
        SUM(PHAI_THU)        AS PHAI_THU,
        SUM(TIEN)                AS TIEN,
        SUM(NO_PT)/NULLIF(SUM(VCSH),0) AS D_E

        AND report_year = :p_year
        AND report_quarter = :p_quarter

  JOIN ids.company_data cd ON d.COMPANY_PROFILE_ID  = cd.COMPANY_PROFILE_ID AND cd.report_year=d.report_year AND cd.report_quarter=d.report_quarter

WITH Company_data_chuan AS (...),
Chitiet_DN as (...)
--Bước 1,2, giống mục 7
/* -------------------------------------------
BƯỚC 3.2: Nếu tính các chỉ tiêu theo sàn, ngành
*/
SELECT 
        equity_listing_exch, category_l1_id,
        report_year, report_quarter,
        c.INDUSTRY_CD||'-'||c.INDUSTRY_NAME AS NNKD,
        count(1)         AS SL,
        SUM(TAI_SAN) AS TAI_SAN,
        SUM(NO_PT)         AS NO_PT,
        SUM(VCSH)        AS VCSH,
        SUM(VDL)        AS VDL,
        SUM(LNST)        AS LNST,
        --Nếu đầu kỳ null thì mẫu số =(cuối + cuối)/2 = cuối, tương tự nếu cuối kỳ null thì mẫu số = đầu, nếu cả 2 null thì ROA=null
        SUM(LNST)/NULLIF(SUM((NVL(TAI_SAN_DK, TAI_SAN)+ NVL(TAI_SAN, TAI_SAN_DK))/2),0)*100 as ROA,        
        SUM(LNST)/NULLIF(SUM((NVL(VCSH_DK, VCSH)+ NVL(VCSH, VCSH_DK))/2),0)*100 as ROE,
        SUM(TAI_SAN_DK)        AS TAI_SAN_DK,
        SUM(HTK)                AS HTK,
        SUM(DOANH_THU)        AS DOANH_THU,
        SUM(LN_YTD)         AS LN_YTD,
        SUM(PHAI_THU)        AS PHAI_THU,
        SUM(TIEN)                AS TIEN,
        SUM(NO_PT)/NULLIF(SUM(VCSH),0) AS D_E
FROM Chitiet_DN ct
LEFT JOIN GMS_IDS_UAT.CATEGORIES c ON c.ID = ct.category_l1_id
where 1=1 
        AND report_year = :p_year
        AND report_quarter = :p_quarter
        AND equity_listing_exch= 'OTC'
GROUP BY equity_listing_exch, category_l1_id, report_year, report_quarter, c.INDUSTRY_CD||'-'||c.INDUSTRY_NAME
ORDER BY equity_listing_exch, category_l1_id, report_year, report_quarter

-- ROA = LNST / Tổng tài sản bình quân * 100%
 -- TSBQ = (TS đầu kỳ + TS cuối kỳ) / 2
 WITH ts_bq AS (
  SELECT cd.id,
  SUM(CASE WHEN rc2.col_desc = '2' THEN d.data_value ELSE 0 END) AS ts_dau,
  SUM(CASE WHEN rc2.col_desc = '1' THEN d.data_value ELSE 0 END) AS ts_cuoi
  FROM IDS.data d
  JOIN IDS.report_catalog rc ON d.report_catalog_id=rc.id
 JOIN IDS.rrow rr ON rr.row_cd = d.row_cd AND rr.report_catalog_id = d.report_catalog_id
 JOIN IDS.rcol rc2 ON rc2.col_cd = d.col_cd AND rc2.report_catalog_id = d.report_catalog_id
  JOIN ids.company_data cd ON d.COMPANY_PROFILE_ID  = cd.COMPANY_PROFILE_ID AND cd.report_year=d.report_year AND cd.report_quarter=d.report_quarter
  WHERE cd.report_year=:year AND cd.report_quarter=:quarter
  AND rc.report_cd LIKE 'BCDKT%'
  AND ((upper(rc.enterprise_type_cd)='DN' AND rr.row_desc='270')
  OR (upper(rc.enterprise_type_cd)='BH' AND rr.row_desc='270')
  OR (upper(rc.enterprise_type_cd)='TD' AND rr.row_desc='300'))
  GROUP BY cd.id
 ), lnst AS (
  SELECT cd.id, SUM(d.data_value) AS lnst
  FROM IDS.data d
  JOIN IDS.report_catalog rc ON d.report_catalog_id=rc.id
 JOIN IDS.rrow rr ON rr.row_cd = d.row_cd AND rr.report_catalog_id = d.report_catalog_id
 JOIN IDS.rcol rc2 ON rc2.col_cd = d.col_cd AND rc2.report_catalog_id = d.report_catalog_id
  JOIN ids.company_data cd ON d.COMPANY_PROFILE_ID  = cd.COMPANY_PROFILE_ID AND cd.report_year=d.report_year AND cd.report_quarter=d.report_quarter
  WHERE rc2.col_desc = '1'
  AND rc.report_cd LIKE 'BCKQKD%' AND d.report_year=:year AND d.report_quarter=:quarter
  AND ((upper(rc.enterprise_type_cd)='DN' AND rr.row_desc='60')
  OR (upper(rc.enterprise_type_cd)='BH' AND rr.row_desc='60')
  OR (upper(rc.enterprise_type_cd)='TD' AND rr.row_desc='21'))
  GROUP BY cd.id
 )
 SELECT cdet.category_l1_id, cdet.equity_listing_exch, SUM(l.lnst) / NULLIF(SUM(
  CASE WHEN t.ts_dau IS NULL THEN t.ts_cuoi
  WHEN t.ts_cuoi IS NULL THEN t.ts_dau
  ELSE (t.ts_dau+t.ts_cuoi)/2 END),0)*100 AS roa_pct
 FROM ts_bq t JOIN lnst l ON l.id=t.id
JOIN IDS.company_profiles cdet ON cdet.id=t.company_profile_id

GROUP BY cdet.category_l1_id, cdet.equity_listing_exch

WITH
/* BƯỚC 1:
   Xác định đúng 1 company_data cho mỗi NNT + kỳ:
   - company_data phải APPROVED
   - Ưu tiên loại báo cáo: HN -> TH -> ME -> RI
   - Trong cùng loại báo cáo: lấy submission_date mới nhất
*/
Company_data_chuan AS (
    SELECT
        company_profile_id,
        report_year,
        report_quarter,
        company_data_id,
        form_cd, form_tp,
        submission_date
    FROM (
        SELECT
            cd.company_profile_id,
            cd.report_year,
            cd.report_quarter,
            cd.id AS company_data_id,
            f.form_cd,
                        substr(f.form_cd,1,2) as form_tp,
            cd.submission_date,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY cd.company_profile_id, cd.report_year, cd.report_quarter
                ORDER BY CASE         WHEN f.form_cd LIKE 'HN%' THEN 1
                                                                WHEN f.form_cd LIKE 'TH%' THEN 2
                                                                WHEN f.form_cd LIKE 'ME%' THEN 3
                                                                WHEN f.form_cd LIKE 'RI%' THEN 4
                                                        END, cd.submission_date DESC) AS rn
        FROM GMS_IDS_UAT.company_data cd
        JOIN GMS_IDS_UAT.forms f ON f.id = cd.form_id AND f.news_type_cd = 'DINH_KY'
        WHERE cd.news_status_cd = 'APPROVED'
    )
    WHERE rn = 1
),
/* =========================================================
   BƯỚC 2: tính các chỉ tiêu theo từng DN, từng kỳ
   - Từ các kỳ hợp lệ ở trên, lấy chỉ tiêu trong DATA
   - DATA join bằng: company_profile_id + report_year + report_quarter
   - Điều kiện FINANCIAL_STATEMENT_CD = form_tp
   - Cùng chỉ tiêu: lấy create_date mới nhất
   ========================================================= */
Chitiet_DN as
(        SELECT
                company_profile_id, equity_ticker, equity_listing_exch, category_l1_id, enterprise_type_cd, 
                report_year, report_quarter,report_cd, col_desc, row_desc,
                data_value
        FROM (
                Select x.*,
                ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY x.company_profile_id, x.report_year, x.report_quarter, x.row_id ORDER BY x.created_date DESC ) AS rn
                FROM (
                        SELECT 
                                cdc.company_profile_id, cp.equity_ticker, cp.equity_listing_exch, cp.category_l1_id , rc.enterprise_type_cd,
                                cdc.report_year, cdc.report_quarter,rc.report_cd, rc2.id as col_id, rc2.col_desc, rr.id as row_id, rr.row_desc,
                                d.data_value,
                                d.created_date,
                        FROM Company_data_chuan cdc
                        JOIN GMS_IDS_UAT.company_profiles cp ON cp.id = cdc.company_profile_id
                        JOIN GMS_IDS_UAT.data d ON d.company_profile_id = cdc.company_profile_id
                                AND d.report_year = cdc.report_year
                                AND d.report_quarter = cdc.report_quarter
                        JOIN GMS_IDS_UAT.report_catalog rc ON rc.id = d.report_catalog_id and cdc.form_tp = rc.FINANCIAL_STATEMENT_CD
                        JOIN GMS_IDS_UAT.rrow rr ON rr.row_cd = d.row_cd AND rr.report_catalog_id = d.report_catalog_id
                        JOIN GMS_IDS_UAT.rcol rc2 ON rc2.col_cd = d.col_cd AND rc2.report_catalog_id = d.report_catalog_id
                        WHERE UPPER(rc.enterprise_type_cd) = 'DN'
                                AND rc.report_cd LIKE 'BCDKT%'
                                AND rc2.col_desc = '1'--chỉ tiêu cuối kỳ, thay bằng 2 để test chỉ tiêu cuối kỳ
                                AND cd.report_year = :year
                                AND cd.report_quarter = :quarter
                        ) x
                )
        WHERE rn = 1
)
/* ----------------------------------------
BƯỚC 3.1: Nếu tính các chỉ tiêu chi tiết DN
*/
SELECT c.INDUSTRY_CD||'-'||c.INDUSTRY_NAME AS NNKD, cd.* 
FROM Chitiet_DN cd
LEFT JOIN GMS_IDS_UAT.CATEGORIES c ON c.ID = cd.category_l1_id

SELECT 
        cp.ID, cp.COMPANY_NAME_VN , cp.EQUITY_TICKER , cp.bond_ticker, 
        cp.category_l1_id, c.INDUSTRY_CD||'-'||c.INDUSTRY_NAME AS NNKD,--thêm đk này trong dataexplorer
        aa.*
FROM GMS_IDS_UAT.company_profiles cp 
JOIN 
(        SELECT * 
        FROM (--điểm cấp 2
                SELECT ev.evaluation_date,
                company_id, ep.YEAR||lpad(ep.MONTH,2,0) AS per
                , eg.group_cd, sum(ed.score) AS diem
                FROM GMS_IDS_UAT.evaluations ev
                JOIN GMS_IDS_UAT.evaluation_periods ep ON ep.id = ev.period_id AND upper(ep.STATUS) ='APPROVED'
                JOIN GMS_IDS_UAT.evaluation_details ed ON ed.evaluation_id = ev.id
                JOIN GMS_IDS_UAT.evaluation_criteria ec ON ec.id = ed.criterion_id
                JOIN GMS_IDS_UAT.evaluation_groups eg ON eg.id = ec.group_id
                WHERE 1=1
                AND eg.group_cd IN ('TUAN_THU', 'PHAT_HANH', 'TAI_CHINH', 'PHI_TAI_CHINH')
                Group by company_id, eg.group_cd, ep.YEAR||lpad(ep.MONTH,2,0), ev.evaluation_date
                --        điểm tổng (cấp 1)
                UNION ALL
                SELECT ev.evaluation_date        ,
                company_id, ep.YEAR||lpad(ep.MONTH,2,0) AS per
                , 'TONG' group_cd, ev.total_score AS diem
                FROM GMS_IDS_UAT.evaluations ev
                JOIN GMS_IDS_UAT.evaluation_periods ep ON ep.id = ev.period_id AND upper(ep.STATUS) ='APPROVED'
                WHERE 1=1
                --điểm cấp 3
                UNION ALL
                SELECT ev.evaluation_date,
                company_id, ep.YEAR||lpad(ep.MONTH,2,0) AS per
                , criterion_cd, ed.score AS diem_phat_hanh_nhanh
                FROM GMS_IDS_UAT.evaluation_details ed
                JOIN GMS_IDS_UAT.evaluation_criteria ec ON ec.id = ed.criterion_id
                JOIN GMS_IDS_UAT.evaluation_groups eg ON eg.id = ec.group_id
                JOIN GMS_IDS_UAT.evaluations ev ON ev.id = ed.evaluation_id
                JOIN GMS_IDS_UAT.evaluation_periods ep ON ep.id = ev.period_id AND upper(ep.STATUS) ='APPROVED'
                WHERE ec.criterion_cd = 'PHAT_HANH_TIN_NHIEM'
                AND eg.group_cd = 'PHAT_HANH'
                )
        pivot  (sum(diem)
                FOR group_cd IN ('TONG' AS TONG, 'TUAN_THU' AS TUAN_THU, 'PHAT_HANH' AS PHAT_HANH, 'TAI_CHINH' AS TAI_CHINH, 'PHI_TAI_CHINH' AS PHI_TAI_CHINH
                                                ,'PHAT_HANH_TIN_NHIEM' AS PHAT_HANH_TIN_NHIEM
                                                )
                        ) 
) aa ON cp.id = aa.COMPANY_ID 
LEFT JOIN GMS_IDS_UAT.CATEGORIES c ON c.ID = cp.category_l1_id--thêm trong dataexxplorer
--AND cp.EQUITY_TICKER = 'DNL'
AND per = '202607'

SELECT

	cp.category_l1_id, c.INDUSTRY_CD||'-'||c.INDUSTRY_NAME AS NNKD,--thêm đk này trong dataexplorer
	aa.*
FROM GMS_IDS_UAT.company_profiles cp 
JOIN 
(	SELECT * 
	FROM (--điểm cấp 3
		SELECT ev.evaluation_date,
		company_id, ep.YEAR||lpad(ep.MONTH,2,0) AS per
		, criterion_cd, ed.score AS diem
		FROM GMS_IDS_UAT.evaluation_details ed
		JOIN GMS_IDS_UAT.evaluation_criteria ec ON ec.id = ed.criterion_id
		JOIN GMS_IDS_UAT.evaluation_groups eg ON eg.id = ec.group_id
		JOIN GMS_IDS_UAT.evaluations ev ON ev.id = ed.evaluation_id
		JOIN GMS_IDS_UAT.evaluation_periods ep ON ep.id = ev.period_id AND upper(ep.STATUS) ='APPROVED'
		WHERE 1=1
		AND eg.group_cd = 'TUAN_THU'
		AND ec.criterion_cd in ('TUAN_THU_BCTC', 'TUAN_THU_BCTN', 'TUAN_THU_BCTHQT', 'TUAN_THU_CBTTBT_TDTGD', 'TUAN_THU_VP_UBCK', 
								'TUAN_THU_CBTTBT_VPVT', 'TUAN_THU_QTCT_DLCT', 'TUAN_THU_QTCT_SLDHDCD', 'TUAN_THU_QTCT_SLTVDL', 'TUAN_THU_QTCT_SLTVKDH', 
								'TUAN_THU_QTCT_TCTV', 'TUAN_THU_QTCT_SLTVBKS', 'TUAN_THU_BCSDV_BCTDSDV', 'TUAN_THU_BCSDV_TDPASDV')
		--điểm cấp 2
		UNION ALL
		SELECT ev.evaluation_date,
		company_id, ep.YEAR||lpad(ep.MONTH,2,0) AS per
		, eg.group_cd, sum(ed.score) AS diem
		FROM GMS_IDS_UAT.evaluations ev
		JOIN GMS_IDS_UAT.evaluation_periods ep ON ep.id = ev.period_id AND upper(ep.STATUS) ='APPROVED'
		JOIN GMS_IDS_UAT.evaluation_details ed ON ed.evaluation_id = ev.id
		JOIN GMS_IDS_UAT.evaluation_criteria ec ON ec.id = ed.criterion_id
		JOIN GMS_IDS_UAT.evaluation_groups eg ON eg.id = ec.group_id
		WHERE 1=1
		AND eg.group_cd = 'TUAN_THU'
		Group by company_id, eg.group_cd, ep.YEAR||lpad(ep.MONTH,2,0), ev.evaluation_date
		)
	pivot  (sum(diem)
		FOR criterion_cd IN ('TUAN_THU' AS TONG, 'TUAN_THU_BCTC' AS BCTC, 'TUAN_THU_BCTN' AS BCTN, 'TUAN_THU_BCTHQT' AS BCTHQT, 'TUAN_THU_CBTTBT_TDTGD' AS CBTTBT_TDTGD, 'TUAN_THU_VP_UBCK' AS VP_UBCK,

						)
			) 
) aa ON cp.id = aa.COMPANY_ID

SELECT cp.equity_ticker AS ma_ck
  FROM company_profiles cp
  WHERE cp.status_ids_cd = 'APPROVED_PUBLIC'
column20:
SELECT 
	cp.ID, cp.COMPANY_NAME_VN , cp.EQUITY_TICKER , cp.bond_ticker, 
	cp.category_l1_id, c.INDUSTRY_CD||'-'||c.INDUSTRY_NAME AS NNKD,--thêm đk này trong dataexplorer
	aa.*
FROM GMS_IDS_UAT.company_profiles cp 
JOIN 
(	SELECT * 
	FROM (--điểm cấp 3
		SELECT ev.evaluation_date,
		company_id, ep.YEAR||lpad(ep.MONTH,2,0) AS per
		, criterion_cd, ed.score AS diem
		FROM GMS_IDS_UAT.evaluation_details ed
		JOIN GMS_IDS_UAT.evaluation_criteria ec ON ec.id = ed.criterion_id
		JOIN GMS_IDS_UAT.evaluation_groups eg ON eg.id = ec.group_id
		JOIN GMS_IDS_UAT.evaluations ev ON ev.id = ed.evaluation_id
		JOIN GMS_IDS_UAT.evaluation_periods ep ON ep.id = ev.period_id AND upper(ep.STATUS) ='APPROVED'
		WHERE 1=1
		AND eg.group_cd = 'TAI_CHINH'
		AND ec.criterion_cd in ('TAI_CHINH_YKKT', 'TAI_CHINH_DTTHDKD', 'TAI_CHINH_KNTTHT', 'TAI_CHINH_EBIT', 'TAI_CHINH_NO_VON_CSH',
              'TAI_CHINH_VON_CSH', 'TAI_CHINH_ROA', 'TAI_CHINH_ROE', 'TAI_CHINH_DTHDTC_LNST', 'TAI_CHINH_DTHD_KHAC_LNST')
		--điểm cấp 2
		UNION ALL
		SELECT ev.evaluation_date,
		company_id, ep.YEAR||lpad(ep.MONTH,2,0) AS per
		, eg.group_cd, sum(ed.score) AS diem
		FROM GMS_IDS_UAT.evaluations ev
		JOIN GMS_IDS_UAT.evaluation_periods ep ON ep.id = ev.period_id AND upper(ep.STATUS) ='APPROVED'
		JOIN GMS_IDS_UAT.evaluation_details ed ON ed.evaluation_id = ev.id
		JOIN GMS_IDS_UAT.evaluation_criteria ec ON ec.id = ed.criterion_id
		JOIN GMS_IDS_UAT.evaluation_groups eg ON eg.id = ec.group_id
		WHERE 1=1
		AND eg.group_cd = 'TAI_CHINH'
		Group by company_id, eg.group_cd, ep.YEAR||lpad(ep.MONTH,2,0), ev.evaluation_date
		)
	pivot  (sum(diem)
		FOR criterion_cd IN ('TAI_CHINH' AS TONG, 'TAI_CHINH_YKKT' AS YKKT, 'TAI_CHINH_DTTHDKD' AS DTTHDKD, 'TAI_CHINH_KNTTHT' AS KNTTHT, 'TAI_CHINH_EBIT' AS EBIT, 'TAI_CHINH_NO_VON_CSH' AS NO_VON_CSH,
            'TAI_CHINH_VON_CSH' AS VON_CSH, 'TAI_CHINH_ROA' AS ROA, 'TAI_CHINH_ROE' AS ROE, 'TAI_CHINH_DTHDTC_LNST' AS DTHDTC_LNST, 'TAI_CHINH_DTHD_KHAC_LNST' AS DTHD_KHAC_LNST
						)
			) 
) aa ON cp.id = aa.COMPANY_ID 
LEFT JOIN GMS_IDS_UAT.CATEGORIES c ON c.ID = cp.category_l1_id--thêm trong dataexxplorer
--AND cp.EQUITY_TICKER = 'DNL'
AND per = '202607'

column3: Dữ liệu về phân loại công ty đại chúng theo chỉ tiêu phát hành
column4: Mã doanh nghiệp
column9: Tháng, sàn, Ngành, CTDC
column18: cp.status_ids_cd = 'APPROVED_PUBLIC'
column19:
SELECT cp.equity_ticker AS ma_ck
  FROM company_profiles cp
  WHERE cp.status_ids_cd = 'APPROVED_PUBLIC'
column20:
SELECT 
        cp.ID, cp.COMPANY_NAME_VN , cp.EQUITY_TICKER , cp.bond_ticker, 
        cp.category_l1_id, c.INDUSTRY_CD||'-'||c.INDUSTRY_NAME AS NNKD,--thêm đk này trong dataexplorer
        aa.*
FROM GMS_IDS_UAT.company_profiles cp JOIN 
(        SELECT * 
        FROM (--điểm cấp 3
                SELECT ev.evaluation_date,
                company_id, ep.YEAR||lpad(ep.MONTH,2,0) AS per
                , criterion_cd, ed.score AS diem
                FROM GMS_IDS_UAT.evaluation_details ed
                JOIN GMS_IDS_UAT.evaluation_criteria ec ON ec.id = ed.criterion_id
                JOIN GMS_IDS_UAT.evaluation_groups eg ON eg.id = ec.group_id
                JOIN GMS_IDS_UAT.evaluations ev ON ev.id = ed.evaluation_id
                JOIN GMS_IDS_UAT.evaluation_periods ep ON ep.id = ev.period_id AND upper(ep.STATUS) ='APPROVED'
                WHERE 1=1
                AND eg.group_cd = 'PHAT_HANH'
                AND ec.criterion_cd in ('PHAT_HANH_TANG_VON_NHANH', 'PHAT_HANH_SLCBCPRL', 'PHAT_HANH_SLCBRCC', 'PHAT_HANH_SLPHES',
                                                      'PHAT_HANH_TLGTTP', 'PHAT_HANH_TIN_NHIEM', 'PHAT_HANH_DNTPTVCSH')
                --điểm cấp 2
                UNION ALL
                SELECT ev.evaluation_date,
                company_id, ep.YEAR||lpad(ep.MONTH,2,0) AS per
                , eg.group_cd, sum(ed.score) AS diem
                FROM GMS_IDS_UAT.evaluations ev
                JOIN GMS_IDS_UAT.evaluation_periods ep ON ep.id = ev.period_id AND upper(ep.STATUS) ='APPROVED'
                JOIN GMS_IDS_UAT.evaluation_details ed ON ed.evaluation_id = ev.id
                JOIN GMS_IDS_UAT.evaluation_criteria ec ON ec.id = ed.criterion_id
                JOIN GMS_IDS_UAT.evaluation_groups eg ON eg.id = ec.group_id
                WHERE 1=1
                AND eg.group_cd = 'PHAT_HANH'
                Group by company_id, eg.group_cd, ep.YEAR||lpad(ep.MONTH,2,0), ev.evaluation_date
                )
        pivot  (sum(diem)
                FOR criterion_cd IN ('PHAT_HANH' AS TONG, 'PHAT_HANH_TANG_VON_NHANH' AS TANG_VON_NHANH, 'PHAT_HANH_SLCBCPRL' AS SLCBCPRL, 'PHAT_HANH_SLCBRCC' AS SLCBRCC,
                                                        'PHAT_HANH_SLPHES' AS SLPHES, 'PHAT_HANH_TLGTTP' AS TLGTTP, 'PHAT_HANH_TIN_NHIEM' AS TIN_NHIEM, 'PHAT_HANH_DNTPTVCSH' AS DNTPTVCSH
                                                )
                        ) 
) aa ON cp.id = aa.COMPANY_ID 
LEFT JOIN GMS_IDS_UAT.CATEGORIES c ON c.ID = cp.category_l1_id--thêm trong dataexxplorer
--AND cp.EQUITY_TICKER = 'DNL'
AND per = '202607'

SELECT

	cp.category_l1_id, c.INDUSTRY_CD||'-'||c.INDUSTRY_NAME AS NNKD,--thêm đk này trong dataexplorer
	aa.*
FROM GMS_IDS_UAT.company_profiles cp 
JOIN 
(	SELECT * 
	FROM (--điểm cấp 3
		SELECT ev.evaluation_date,
		company_id, ep.YEAR||lpad(ep.MONTH,2,0) AS per
		, criterion_cd, ed.score AS diem
		FROM GMS_IDS_UAT.evaluation_details ed
		JOIN GMS_IDS_UAT.evaluation_criteria ec ON ec.id = ed.criterion_id
		JOIN GMS_IDS_UAT.evaluation_groups eg ON eg.id = ec.group_id
		JOIN GMS_IDS_UAT.evaluations ev ON ev.id = ed.evaluation_id
		JOIN GMS_IDS_UAT.evaluation_periods ep ON ep.id = ev.period_id AND upper(ep.STATUS) ='APPROVED'
		WHERE 1=1
		AND eg.group_cd = 'PHI_TAI_CHINH'
		AND ec.criterion_cd in ('PHI_TAI_CHINH_TTHD', 'PHI_TAI_CHINH_M_SCORE')
		--điểm cấp 2
		UNION ALL
		SELECT ev.evaluation_date,
		company_id, ep.YEAR||lpad(ep.MONTH,2,0) AS per
		, eg.group_cd, sum(ed.score) AS diem
		FROM GMS_IDS_UAT.evaluations ev
		JOIN GMS_IDS_UAT.evaluation_periods ep ON ep.id = ev.period_id AND upper(ep.STATUS) ='APPROVED'
		JOIN GMS_IDS_UAT.evaluation_details ed ON ed.evaluation_id = ev.id
		JOIN GMS_IDS_UAT.evaluation_criteria ec ON ec.id = ed.criterion_id
		JOIN GMS_IDS_UAT.evaluation_groups eg ON eg.id = ec.group_id
		WHERE 1=1
		AND eg.group_cd = 'PHI_TAI_CHINH'
		Group by company_id, eg.group_cd, ep.YEAR||lpad(ep.MONTH,2,0), ev.evaluation_date
		)
	pivot  (sum(diem)
		FOR criterion_cd IN ('PHI_TAI_CHINH' AS TONG, 'PHI_TAI_CHINH_TTHD' AS TTHD, 'PHI_TAI_CHINH_M_SCORE' AS M_SCORE
						)
			) 
) aa ON cp.id = aa.COMPANY_ID 
LEFT JOIN GMS_IDS_UAT.CATEGORIES c ON c.ID = cp.category_l1_id--thêm trong dataexxplorer

        SUM(LNST)/NULLIF(SUM((NVL(TAI_SAN_DK, TAI_SAN)+ NVL(TAI_SAN, TAI_SAN_DK))/2),0)*100 as ROA,

column13:
-- BC01.2: Tổng hợp DTT, LNST, ROA, ROE theo ngành, kỳ năm (report_quarter IS NULL)
 -- Năm N = :year_n, Năm N-1 = :year_n - 1
 WITH kqkd AS (
  -- DTT và LNST từ BCKQKD, kỳ năm
  SELECT cat.industry_cd, cat.industry_name, cd.report_year,
  SUM(CASE WHEN (upper(rc.enterprise_type_cd)='DN' AND rr.row_desc='10')
  OR (upper(rc.enterprise_type_cd)='BH' AND rr.row_desc='10')
  OR (upper(rc.enterprise_type_cd)='TD' AND rr.row_desc='03') THEN d.data_value END) AS dtt,
  SUM(CASE WHEN (upper(rc.enterprise_type_cd)='DN' AND rr.row_desc='60')
  OR (upper(rc.enterprise_type_cd)='BH' AND rr.row_desc='60')
  OR (upper(rc.enterprise_type_cd)='TD' AND rr.row_desc='21') THEN d.data_value END) AS lnst
  FROM IDS.data d
 JOIN IDS.report_catalog rc ON d.report_catalog_id=rc.id
 JOIN IDS.rrow rr ON rr.row_cd=d.row_cd AND rr.report_catalog_id=d.report_catalog_id
 JOIN IDS.rcol rc2 ON rc2.col_cd=d.col_cd AND rc2.report_catalog_id=d.report_catalog_id
 JOIN ids.company_data cd ON d.COMPANY_PROFILE_ID  = cd.COMPANY_PROFILE_ID AND cd.report_year=d.report_year AND cd.report_quarter=d.report_quarter
 JOIN IDS.company_profiles cp ON cp.id=d.company_profile_id
 JOIN IDS.categories cat ON cat.id=cp.category_l1_id
  WHERE rc2.col_desc='1' AND rc.report_cd LIKE 'BCKQKD%'
  AND cd.report_quarter IS NULL
  AND cd.report_year IN (:year_n, :year_n-1)
  GROUP BY cat.industry_cd, cat.industry_name, cd.report_year
 ), bcdkt AS (
  -- TS và VCSH từ BCĐKT, cả cuối kỳ (col_desc='1') và đầu kỳ (col_desc='2') để tính bình quân
  SELECT cat.industry_cd, cd.report_year,
  SUM(CASE WHEN ((upper(rc.enterprise_type_cd)='DN' AND rr.row_desc='270')
  OR (upper(rc.enterprise_type_cd)='BH' AND rr.row_desc='270')
  OR (upper(rc.enterprise_type_cd)='TD' AND rr.row_desc='300')) AND rc2.col_desc='1' THEN d.data_value END) AS ts_cuoi,
  SUM(CASE WHEN ((upper(rc.enterprise_type_cd)='DN' AND rr.row_desc='270')
  OR (upper(rc.enterprise_type_cd)='BH' AND rr.row_desc='270')
  OR (upper(rc.enterprise_type_cd)='TD' AND rr.row_desc='300')) AND rc2.col_desc='2' THEN d.data_value END) AS ts_dau,
  SUM(CASE WHEN ((upper(rc.enterprise_type_cd)='DN' AND rr.row_desc='400')
  OR (upper(rc.enterprise_type_cd)='BH' AND rr.row_desc='400')
  OR (upper(rc.enterprise_type_cd)='TD' AND rr.row_desc='500')) AND rc2.col_desc='1' THEN d.data_value END) AS vcsh_cuoi,
  SUM(CASE WHEN ((upper(rc.enterprise_type_cd)='DN' AND rr.row_desc='400')
  OR (upper(rc.enterprise_type_cd)='BH' AND rr.row_desc='400')
  OR (upper(rc.enterprise_type_cd)='TD' AND rr.row_desc='500')) AND rc2.col_desc='2' THEN d.data_value END) AS vcsh_dau
  FROM IDS.data d
 JOIN IDS.report_catalog rc ON d.report_catalog_id=rc.id
 JOIN IDS.rrow rr ON rr.row_cd=d.row_cd AND rr.report_catalog_id=d.report_catalog_id
 JOIN IDS.rcol rc2 ON rc2.col_cd=d.col_cd AND rc2.report_catalog_id=d.report_catalog_id
 JOIN ids.company_data cd ON d.COMPANY_PROFILE_ID  = cd.COMPANY_PROFILE_ID AND cd.report_year=d.report_year AND cd.report_quarter=d.report_quarter
 JOIN IDS.company_profiles cp ON cp.id=d.company_profile_id
 JOIN IDS.categories cat ON cat.id=cp.category_l1_id
  WHERE rc2.col_desc IN ('1','2') AND rc.report_cd LIKE 'BCDKT%'
  AND cd.report_quarter IS NULL
  AND cd.report_year IN (:year_n, :year_n-1)
  GROUP BY cat.industry_cd, cd.report_year
 )
 SELECT k.industry_cd, k.industry_name,
  -- Năm N
  MAX(CASE WHEN k.report_year=:year_n THEN ROUND(k.dtt/1e9,2) END) AS dtt_nam_n,
  MAX(CASE WHEN k.report_year=:year_n THEN ROUND(k.lnst/1e9,2) END) AS lnst_nam_n,
  MAX(CASE WHEN k.report_year=:year_n THEN ROUND(k.lnst/NULLIF((b.ts_cuoi+b.ts_dau)/2,0)*100,4) END) AS roa_nam_n,
  MAX(CASE WHEN k.report_year=:year_n THEN ROUND(k.lnst/NULLIF((b.vcsh_cuoi+b.vcsh_dau)/2,0)*100,4) END) AS roe_nam_n,
  -- Năm N-1
  MAX(CASE WHEN k.report_year=:year_n-1 THEN ROUND(k.dtt/1e9,2) END) AS dtt_nam_n1,
  MAX(CASE WHEN k.report_year=:year_n-1 THEN ROUND(k.lnst/1e9,2) END) AS lnst_nam_n1,
  MAX(CASE WHEN k.report_year=:year_n-1 THEN ROUND(k.lnst/NULLIF((b.ts_cuoi+b.ts_dau)/2,0)*100,4) END) AS roa_nam_n1,
  MAX(CASE WHEN k.report_year=:year_n-1 THEN ROUND(k.lnst/NULLIF((b.vcsh_cuoi+b.vcsh_dau)/2,0)*100,4) END) AS roe_nam_n1
 FROM kqkd k
 JOIN bcdkt b ON b.industry_cd=k.industry_cd AND b.report_year=k.report_year
 GROUP BY k.industry_cd, k.industry_name
 ORDER BY k.industry_cd

WITH bcdkt AS (
  SELECT
  SUM(CASE WHEN ((upper(rc.enterprise_type_cd)='DN' AND rr.row_desc='270') OR (upper(rc.enterprise_type_cd)='BH' AND rr.row_desc='270') OR (upper(rc.enterprise_type_cd)='TD' AND rr.row_desc='300')) AND rc2.col_desc='1' THEN d.data_value END) AS tts_cuoi,
  SUM(CASE WHEN ((upper(rc.enterprise_type_cd)='DN' AND rr.row_desc='270') OR (upper(rc.enterprise_type_cd)='BH' AND rr.row_desc='270') OR (upper(rc.enterprise_type_cd)='TD' AND rr.row_desc='300')) AND rc2.col_desc='2' THEN d.data_value END) AS tts_dau,
  SUM(CASE WHEN ((upper(rc.enterprise_type_cd)='DN' AND rr.row_desc='300') OR (upper(rc.enterprise_type_cd)='BH' AND rr.row_desc='300') OR (upper(rc.enterprise_type_cd)='TD' AND rr.row_desc='400')) AND rc2.col_desc='1' THEN d.data_value END) AS npt,
  SUM(CASE WHEN ((upper(rc.enterprise_type_cd)='DN' AND rr.row_desc='400') OR (upper(rc.enterprise_type_cd)='BH' AND rr.row_desc='400') OR (upper(rc.enterprise_type_cd)='TD' AND rr.row_desc='500')) AND rc2.col_desc='1' THEN d.data_value END) AS vcsh_cuoi,
  SUM(CASE WHEN ((upper(rc.enterprise_type_cd)='DN' AND rr.row_desc='400') OR (upper(rc.enterprise_type_cd)='BH' AND rr.row_desc='400') OR (upper(rc.enterprise_type_cd)='TD' AND rr.row_desc='500')) AND rc2.col_desc='2' THEN d.data_value END) AS vcsh_dau,
  SUM(CASE WHEN ((upper(rc.enterprise_type_cd)='DN' AND rr.row_desc='411') OR (upper(rc.enterprise_type_cd)='BH' AND rr.row_desc='411') OR (upper(rc.enterprise_type_cd)='TD' AND rr.row_desc='411')) AND rc2.col_desc='1' THEN d.data_value END) AS vdl
  FROM IDS.data d
  JOIN IDS.report_catalog rc ON d.report_catalog_id=rc.id
  JOIN IDS.rrow rr ON rr.row_cd=d.row_cd AND rr.report_catalog_id=d.report_catalog_id
  JOIN IDS.rcol rc2 ON rc2.col_cd=d.col_cd AND rc2.report_catalog_id=d.report_catalog_id
  JOIN ids.company_data cd ON d.COMPANY_PROFILE_ID  = cd.COMPANY_PROFILE_ID AND cd.report_year=d.report_year AND cd.report_quarter=d.report_quarter
  JOIN IDS.company_profiles cp ON cp.id=d.company_profile_id
  JOIN IDS.categories cat ON cat.id=cp.category_l1_id
  WHERE rc2.col_desc IN ('1','2') AND rc.report_cd LIKE 'BCDKT%'
  AND cd.report_quarter IS NULL AND cd.report_year=:year_n
 ), kqkd AS (
  SELECT SUM(d.data_value) AS lnst
  FROM IDS.data d
  JOIN IDS.report_catalog rc ON d.report_catalog_id=rc.id
  JOIN IDS.rrow rr ON rr.row_cd=d.row_cd AND rr.report_catalog_id=d.report_catalog_id
  JOIN IDS.rcol rc2 ON rc2.col_cd=d.col_cd AND rc2.report_catalog_id=d.report_catalog_id
  JOIN ids.company_data cd ON d.COMPANY_PROFILE_ID  = cd.COMPANY_PROFILE_ID AND cd.report_year=d.report_year AND cd.report_quarter=d.report_quarter
  JOIN IDS.company_profiles cp ON cp.id=d.company_profile_id
  JOIN IDS.categories cat ON cat.id=cp.category_l1_id
  WHERE rc2.col_desc='1' AND rc.report_cd LIKE 'BCKQKD%'
  AND cd.report_quarter IS NULL AND cd.report_year=:year_n
  AND ((upper(rc.enterprise_type_cd)='DN' AND rr.row_desc='60') OR (upper(rc.enterprise_type_cd)='BH' AND rr.row_desc='60') OR (upper(rc.enterprise_type_cd)='TD' AND rr.row_desc='21'))
 )
 SELECT
  ROUND(b.tts_cuoi/1e9,2) AS tts_nam_n,
  ROUND(b.npt/1e9,2) AS npt_nam_n,
  ROUND(b.vcsh_cuoi/1e9,2) AS vcsh_nam_n,
  ROUND(b.vdl/1e9,2) AS vdl_nam_n,
  ROUND(k.lnst/1e9,2) AS lnst_nam_n,
  ROUND(k.lnst/NULLIF((b.tts_cuoi+b.tts_dau)/2,0)*100,4) AS roa_nam_n,
  ROUND(k.lnst/NULLIF((b.vcsh_cuoi+b.vcsh_dau)/2,0)*100,4) AS roe_nam_n
 FROM bcdkt b, kqkd k
